title: Multimodal deep learning prescreens germline BRCA1/2 from slides and health records
summary: MAIGGT is a multi-scale Transformer-based deep learning framework that combines histopathology whole-slide image features with electronic health record phenotypes to prescreen germline BRCA1/2 mutations. Across three independent cohorts it reached AUCs of 0.925, 0.845 and 0.833 and outperformed single-modality models. Interpretability analyses linked BRCA1/2-mutated tumors to inflammatory infiltration, stromal proliferation, necrosis and nuclear heterogeneity. It is a retrospective prescreening tool, not a replacement for genetic testing.
ai_technology: Multi-scale Transformer multimodal deep learning on whole-slide images and electronic health records

evidence.tested: Validation in three independent cohorts, with AUCs 0.925, 0.845 and 0.833.
evidence.unknown: Retrospective; prescreening rather than diagnostic; cohort sizes and clinical utility not stated in the abstract; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Transformer-based multimodal model fuses slide microenvironment features and clinical phenotypes to predict germline BRCA1/2 status.
